info.title: overcrowdin
info.description: .NET Core Global Tool providing a limited but useful Crowdin CLI. Built over the Crowdin.Api (https://github.com/crowdin/crowdin-dotnet-client)

commands.name: updatefiles
commands.description: Update files in Crowdin. Will use crowdin.json or files passed in as arguments.

options.description: Name of the Crowdin branch (overrides any branch in crowdin.json)

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to a file to upload

commands.name: download
commands.description: Download the latest translations from Crowdin

options.name: --branch
